run_load_from_docker_test: run the LoadFromDockerTest to verify dm_fast_mapping.load_from_docker creates a valid environment from a Docker image
run_fast_mapping_task_test: run the parameterized FastMappingTaskTest to verify all FAST_MAPPING_TASK_LEVEL_NAMES load successfully from Docker
test_load_from_docker: test dm_fast_mapping.load_from_docker with EnvironmentSettings seed and level_name to return a non-None environment
test_environment_settings: test EnvironmentSettings with a seed and level_name to configure a Fast Mapping task environment
review_fast_mapping_task_level_names: review the FAST_MAPPING_TASK_LEVEL_NAMES constant to see all available Fast Mapping task levels for parameterized testing
